terrain.about: height(x,z,h): F inside plateauEdge (and over the lists, glacis and south glacis); the ditch at ditchFloor with its faces over exactly one terrain cell; the strip at 0.5 (the zone glue keeps the sea and strand carves); outside the glacis the field noise h, ramped up to the rim. Every level change starts and ends on a 4.667 m grid line where it is axis-aligned (ditch, lists); along the diagonal sea step the scarp stands scarpTopOutboardOfPlat out so the drawn slope stays under its face.
terrain.plateauEdge: walls.plateauEdgeRef (the sea curtain offset 3.0 m out), continued south from the SW corner along x = -152 to the plate edge and east from the NE corner along the north cliff: (68.3,106), (100,107), (140,104), (176,100)
terrain.wild: east of glacis.x1 (140) or south of z -135.333 (grid k 46, clear of the ditch end face): F + max(0, h) ramped in over 20 m, pines and rock (the zone glue)

wallStairRules: a wall stair hugs a curtain town face, lands ON the walk through a parados gap (the one bay with no sg_parados), keeps 1.0 m clear of every tower footprint and of every house; the walk loop is continuous through every tower room, the Sea Gate chamber, the Crown Gate gallery and the bastion platform
